response.original_title: How do I escalate a complaint with Xfinity? [Billing Relief]
response.overview: To escalate a complaint with Xfinity, contact ⟨+1⟩ 866 [465] (1426) to speak with a resolution supervisor, or submit your supporting receipts through get help. Providing your statement dates, promo emails, or hardware return tracking IDs lets the supervisor place a dispute hold and adjust your balance.  Dialing ⟨+1⟩ 866 [465] (1426) skips basic phone queues that cannot resolve expired bundle credits and unreturned-equipment flags on closed lines. Once connected with resolution supervisors, a live specialist checks your account and starts the fix on the same call.  Resolving contract and equipment return complaints  You can contact ⟨+1⟩ 866 [465] (1426) to get support whenever you run into unexpected price hikes or unresolved cancellation disputes.
